cases.networkWitness: Cached document, bootstrap/App and route dependency responses recorded HTTP200. The uncached API auth/session request failed against the intentionally stopped server after 1991.084ms. Route imports began after that failure and finished in 3–7ms; about 1.88s then remained before the heading assertion expired. No page-error event was recorded.
cases.classification: Actual offline-route readiness failure. The cache did supply public assets. Account preparation delayed route loading, but the trace does not establish the remaining module/render delay cause or prove a fixture-only defect.
cases.fix: Retain the failure and confirm the exact original case serially. Do not cache API/private responses, bypass account hydration globally, increase the assertion budget, or infer that a new preload exclusion is required.

layoutContainmentProposal.sourceReview: No current descendant requires an external absolute/fixed containing block. Home/mastery/ripple children already use relative keycaps; toolbar/help/settings controls are siblings outside the board. Current board does not participate in external baseline alignment.
layoutContainmentProposal.specEffects: Creates an independent formatting context, absolute/fixed containing block and stacking context. Does not enable size or paint containment; visible overflow is treated as ink overflow.
layoutContainmentProposal.conclusion: No concrete current-DOM blocker found. Content-driven size and mapped/native flex contents should remain. This does not eliminate local key-label grid layout, guarantee ancestor invalidation is avoided, or establish a latency benefit.
layoutContainmentProposal.requiredVerificationIfAuthorized: Original four-engine keyboard geometry and interaction assertions, short desktop/mobile layouts, native-character board, multi-key holds, outline/ripple visibility and sibling overlay paint order. Keep size/paint/content containment absent.

limitations: No new runtime observation or browser confirmation was made.
Network timing comes from recorded request start plus total request duration; HTTP200 is not a module-evaluation timestamp.
No memory-pressure, GPU, WebKit module-preload or driver-lifecycle causal claim is established by these traces.
Raw traces remain private ignored artifacts; this report contains no bodies, tokens, user text or account identifiers.
